rules.title: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market (H.5222)
rules.requirement: This Massachusetts bill would address algorithmic rent fixing in rental housing, but it is not law. It was reported favorably by the Joint Committee on Housing on 3/12/2026 and referred to House Ways and Means, so renters have no new rights under it yet.

coverage.summary: Not stated on this page. The bill text is not included, so covered software, landlords and units cannot be determined. As a conduct rule it would presumably apply statewide.

rules.citation: H.5222 (194th General Court; new draft of H.1564)
